item.title: Memory Safety Absolutists
item.description:
📝 Rust devs tend to be passionate about memory safety. I'm hoping, though, that most of the Rust devs, who say they care about memory safety, genuinely care about making software safer, and not just criticizing languages that compete with Rust. Meaning: Rust is unsafe and only Fil-C or Zig's "fil" compilation mode will deal with memory safety related vulnerabilities.
🔗 Read more: https://itsallaboutthebit.com/memory-safety-absolutists/

item.title: Show HN: Writemark, a dependency free web component for inline Markdown editing
item.description:
📝 I like writing Markdown, but do not like writing it inside a plain textarea. I knocked something out, tried using it, found bugs, fixed them, and repeated that cycle until I had something I liked writing in and that performed reasonably well. I like Markdown, and I wanted one component that I could use anywhere without bringing along an entire editor framework.
🔗 Read more: https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=49051130

item.title: Fedora 45 Atomic Desktops Look to Allow for Web-Based Remote Installations
item.description:
📝 This change would benefit all Fedora Atomic Desktop images like Silverblue and Kinoite. Initially this web-based remote install support for Fedora Atomic Desktop images would be treated as a tech preview. Those wishing to learn more about this Fedora 45 Atomic Desktop remote install proposal can find the planning details via the Fedora Wiki.
🔗 Read more: https://www.phoronix.com/news/Fedora-45-Atomic-Remote-Install
